summary: Arterra, a residential building at 300 Berry St. OpenStreetMap tags it as an apartment building and the building permit lists apartments, but the Assessor's 2022 roll classes its unit parcels as condominiums.

milestones.text: Construction permit completed: DBI recorded new-construction permit 200509273964 (16 stories, 268 dwelling units, 300 Berry St) as completed on this date. A permit's completion date is not an opening date.

open_questions: This record was created on 2026-09-27 to host Pier & Point's own field photos. Its summary is limited to what its cited source was re-read to confirm that day; fuller details already in Pier & Point's map notes for this building (developer, architect, unit count, year built) were left out where that source didn't state them. Not yet researched: no milestones, costs or facts.
DBI files the permit under block 8704, lot 001. This record is drawn from OpenStreetMap rather than an Assessor parcel, so the block and lot are not a join to the record.
